2607.07504.title: Do LLM-Generated Skills Make Better AI Data Scientists? A Component Ablation Across Data-Science Workflows
2607.07504.paper_summary: Product data scientists often ask LLM-based agents to help with recurring execution tasks such as cleaning data, writing SQL, choosing statistical tests, and formatting results. Reusable skill files are meant to avoid prompting from scratch by packaging guidance for a task family. Expert-written skills can encode high-quality guidance, but writing and maintaining them across many data-science task families creates a manual bottleneck. We ask whether LLM-generated skills offer a useful low-curation alternative: do they improve performance over the task prompt alone? We test this question across four lifecycle stages: data preparation, data extraction, statistical analysis, and reporting, using one generated skill per stage. We find no reliable improvement from full generated skills over No-Skill prompting. We then ask whether any part of the skill is useful by ablating different skill components. The main ablation covers 56 tasks, nine model configurations, and three providers, yielding 7,560 runs. Compared with prompting using the task alone, neither the full generated skill nor any ablated skill variant significantly improves performance; all p-values are at least 0.396, and the total spread across variants is only 1.2 pp. A supplemental token-matched control adds 1,512 runs and finds that Full skills perform similarly to task-irrelevant skill-formatted content. The results caution against using one LLM-generated skill per data-science workflow as a default single-shot prompting strategy.
2607.07504.paper_summary_zh: 產品數據科學家經常請求基於LLM的代理協助執行重複的任務，例如清理數據、編寫SQL、選擇統計測試和格式化結果。可重用的技能文件旨在通過打包任務系列的指導來避免從頭開始提示。專家編寫的技能可以編碼高質量的指導，但在許多數據科學任務系列中編寫和維護它們會造成手動瓶頸。我們詢問LLM生成的技能是否提供了一種有用的低維護替代方案：它們是否能改善僅依賴任務提示的性能？我們在四個生命周期階段進行了這個問題的測試：數據準備、數據提取、統計分析和報告，每個階段使用一個生成的技能。我們發現完整生成的技能相較於無技能提示並沒有可靠的性能提升。然後，我們詢問技能的任何部分是否有用，通過去除不同的技能組件來進行測試。主要的去除測試涵蓋了56個任務、九種模型配置和三個提供者，共產生了7,560次運行。與僅使用任務提示相比，完整生成的技能或任何去除的技能變體都未顯著改善性能；所有p值至少為0.396，變體之間的總差異僅為1.2個百分點。一個補充的令牌匹配控制增加了1,512次運行，發現完整技能的表現與與任務無關的技能格式內容相似。結果提醒我們，不應將每個數據科學工作流程使用一個LLM生成的技能作為默認的單次提示策略。
2607.07504.author: Wei-Jung Huang et.al.
